title: equity.v1
description: Capability `equity` (SPEC.md section 4.3): legal entities, share classes, plans and pools, stakeholders, option grants with vesting, exercises, an append-only share ledger, cap-table views as of any date, valuation records and illustrative round modelling. Provided by the in-house equity module. THIS IS A TOOL, NOT LEGAL, TAX OR SECURITIES ADVICE: 409A, ISO/NSO limits, tax treatment, 83(b) and ESOP scheme rules are not implemented; they are data fields and documented limits. Equity is a sensitive data class: bodies are JSON over HTTP with a bearer token; authorisation is enforced by the provider per caller, per record and per field (roles employee, manager, hr, finance, board, admin): a caller who may not see a record gets 404, a caller who may see it but not a field or action gets 403. Managers never see the equity of their reports. Quantities are exact decimal strings; prices are integer minor units. Consumers must not depend on anything not in this file.
